[[File:Benny EP146.png|thumb|250px|Benny]] '''Benny''' (Japanese: '''テル''' ''Teru'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP146|Tricks of the Trade]]'', and the [[Original Trainer|original]] {{pkmn|Trainer}} of [[Jessie's Wobbuffet]]. He traveled to [[Palmpona]] for its annual [[Pokémon Swap Meet]], hoping to [[trade]] his Wobbuffet for a new {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that he could raise. Because he was having trouble with that task, {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} tried to help Benny locate a Trainer willing to trade with him. At one point, he briefly contemplated asking if Ash would be interested in trading his {{AP|Tauros}}, but decided not to after he overheard Ash saying that he wasn't there to trade. A Trainer with a {{p|Stantler}} initially wanted to trade with Benny, but bailed at the last minute when he saw a {{p|Hoothoot}} and decided he would rather have a {{type|Flying}} Pokémon. Meanwhile, the [[Magikarp salesman]]—running away from [[James]]—bumped into [[Jessie]] and sent her flying. She bumped into a nearby [[trade machine]] with Benny's Wobbuffet already in it, and Jessie's {{i|Poké Ball}} containing [[Jessie's Lickitung|her Lickitung]] fell into the machine. Unbeknownst to her, the trade went through, and Jessie, not realizing what happened, took the Poké Ball containing Wobbuffet and ran off. By the end of the episode, Benny was showing off his new Lickitung to Ash and his friends.
